fact: SARS says individual taxpayers file returns via eFiling and the SARS MobiApp from 21 July to 20 October 2025, with an outcome in under five seconds for most online returns.

ITWeb reports SARS's 2026 filing season ran auto assessments from 1 to 12 July, with non-provisional taxpayers submitting returns from 13 July to 23 October and some completing a manual eFiling submission.

ITWeb reports SARS had auto-assessed more than 6.9 million returns by 30 September 2026 and improved its eFiling platform for the 2026 filing season, with taxpayers able to meet obligations on digital platforms without visiting a branch.
